prompt: I want to build a meal planning app for busy parents. Run the entire design pipeline for me autonomously -- I trust your judgment on the details, just check in with me at major milestones.

assertions.text: Determines access mode (God mode selected or inferred from 'autonomously')
Sequences through Phase 1 Discovery skills in correct order (big-idea, problem-statement, target-audience, assumptions, competitor-analysis)
Sequences through Phase 2 Strategy skills (storybrand, business-plan, 6p-stories)
Sequences through Phase 3 Planning skills (mvp-requirements, information-architecture)
Sequences through Phase 4 Design & Validation skills (bias-framework, journey-mapping, design-references, figma-workflow, prototyping)
Pauses at user approval checkpoint before Phase 5 development
Manages project state file throughout execution (creates and updates design-docs/project-state.md)
